---
name: Bug report
about: Report unexpected behavior with a synthetic example
---

## What happened?

What did you expect, and what happened instead?

## How can we reproduce it?

Include the smallest example you can with invented activity totals. Mention the commit or image tag, the affected component, and the iOS or server version if relevant.

Keep personal health data, tokens and unredacted logs private. For a security issue, use the [private reporting form](https://github.com/idan-rubin/healthsyncy/security/advisories/new).
